united_earth_is_1: Baninzi kakhulu abantu abafuna ukusindisa iplanethi yethu. Imibutho emininzi, imibutho, iinkampani kunye nabantu abangatshatanga. Kodwa asazi omnye komnye.
united_earth_is_3: Kufuneka sinxibelelane omnye nomnye ukubonisa indlela enamandla ngayo intshukumo yethu. Ukuba siyazi ukuba sibaninzi, sinokunceda abantu ukuba batshintshe iimvakalelo zabo kutshintsho lwemozulu ukuze babe nesibindi nokuzithemba. Singabanika abantu amandla okuba baqale ngokwabo amanyathelo okhuseleko lwemozulu. Sisonke kuphela esinokuthi sitshintshe umhlaba kwaye sihlangule imozulu!
united_earth_is_4: Guqula umhlaba ngokubhalisa kwiwebhusayithi yethu! Singabona baninzi!
united_earth_is_5: Siyakumema ngokufudumeleyo ukuba wabelane ngolwazi olu kunye nabahlobo, amaqabane kunye nabahlobo.
united_earth_is_7: Abafundi abangama-200 nootitshala abangama-30 kwisikolo saseOstriya
about_us_2: Ukuba sibonisa ukuba sibaninzi, sinokubanceda abantu ukuba batshintshe iimvakalelo zabo kutshintsho lwemozulu ukusuka ekuphelelweni ukuya kwinkalipho nokuzithemba. Singabanika abantu amandla okuba baqale ngokwabo amanyathelo okhuseleko lwemozulu.
about_us_3: Kodwa ngaphezulu kwako konke: Asisayi kuziva sodwa kwaye singenamandla kwakhona. Ingasidibanisa. Ingasinika ithemba, ukomelela, isibindi kunye nokuzithemba. Singaziva sinxibelelene nawo wonke umhlaba-sisindisa iplanethi yethu kwaye sisebenzela ikamva elingcono.
about_us_4: Injongo yethu kukunika abantu isibindi, ukuzithemba kunye namandla okuqala amanyathelo abo okhuseleko lwemozulu.
about_us_5: Qaphela: Akukho mfazwe ngenxa yeembono ezahlukeneyo- ukugwetywa, hayi ukunyanzelwa kufuneka ibe sisiseko sokukhusela iplanethi yethu.
about_us_6: Abantu abali-100, bonke bethetha iilwimi ezahlukeneyo, bahamba ngesikhephe besiya ngakwimpophoma. Phantse wonke umntu esikhepheni uyayazi imeko eyingozi. Kodwa phantse wonke umntu ucinga ukuba inguye kuphela owaziyo ngayo. "Ndingenza ntoni?", Wonke umntu ucinga. "Ukuhamba kwelinye icala akunamsebenzi!" Kwaye wonke umntu uzibandakanya kwindlela yesiqhelo yokuziphatha yexesha elidlulileyo. Kuya kwenzeka ntoni ukuba ngequbuliso wonke umntu ebesazi malunga nomnye - esazi ukuba wonke umntu ufuna ukubuyela umva kwaye banokunxibelelana?
about_us_9: Iwebhusayithi kunye namaphepha eendaba ezentlalo axhunyiwe ayenziwe ngabafundi abangama-200 kunye nootitshala kwisikolo saseOstriya.
about_us_10: Le projekthi yenziwa njengeprojekhthi yokuya kwi-ecolabel yase-Austrian. Zonke izinto zewebhusayithi zenziwe njengeprojekthi yesikolo.
about_us_11: Singalandela iinkolo ezahlukeneyo, sahlukile ngeminyaka nangemvelaphi, kodwa sonke sifuna ukusindisa iplanethi yethu. Bonke abathathi-nxaxheba bangamavolontiya.
